claims.statement: Tom Allen advertised a free concert every evening at 619 Market Street.
claims.excerpt: 619 Market street—free concert every evening. Best of singers only engaged here.

claims.statement: Tom Allen styled himself retired champion pugilist of the world.
claims.excerpt: TOM ALLEN, retired champion pugilist of the world, 619 Market street—free concert every evening.

notes: Ad only. The text does not say saloon (the hint says saloon; filed as business).
